name: claude-code-read-only
title: Claude Code, read-only
description: Claude Code run headless in the folder: it reads (Read, Grep, Glob) and may call the MCP tools the caller allows. The runner always passes the shell and write tools as disallowed.

name: codex-read-only
title: Codex, read-only
description: The Codex CLI in exec mode; the runner always runs it in the read-only sandbox. It takes no MCP server: Codex cannot be limited to the allowed tools of one.
